implementation_constraints: reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0

unresolved_intent.decision: treat any json.loads ValueError (malformed JSON, e.g. bare invalid text) as the same ERROR outcome as a well-formed-but-wrong-shape value
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec's 'invalid JSON' example is listed alongside 'not a JSON array' under the same ERROR bucket, so both are folded into one catch-and-print-ERROR path rather than distinguished

unresolved_intent.decision: check isinstance(event, str) before comparing to 'coin'/'push', so numbers/booleans/null/nested arrays inside the event list are rejected as ERROR rather than causing a comparison mismatch that also happens to fall to ERROR
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec explicitly calls out 'a non-string element' as an error case; making the type check explicit keeps that requirement visible in the code rather than relying on accidental equality-comparison behavior

unresolved_intent.decision: stop folding and print ERROR as soon as the first unknown/non-string event is found, rather than scanning the whole array first
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec doesn't say whether to short-circuit or validate-then-fold; short-circuiting is the simpler single-pass implementation and the observable output (ERROR) is identical either way

unresolved_intent.decision: use isinstance(events, list) to reject JSON objects, numbers, strings, booleans, and null uniformly as 'not a JSON array'
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec names 'a JSON object, a bare number' as examples but the contract says 'not a JSON array' generally, so the check is written against the general shape rather than enumerating each disallowed JSON type

unresolved_intent.decision: pass raw sys.stdin.read() directly to json.loads without stripping, relying on json.loads to tolerate surrounding whitespace
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec doesn't mention trailing newlines from piped input; json.loads already ignores leading/trailing whitespace per the JSON grammar, so no extra stripping logic was added
